_comment: P15P local orientation evidence for the three parts JLCPCB has never placed from this project. This is project-side evidence only: it shows that the package footprint, pad nets, silkscreen/fab marks, 3D model and CPL agree with the owner pin maps. It does not show how JLCPCB's own library footprint is oriented; that is confirmed only in JLCPCB's placement preview at the actual order step.
checked_at: 6cb02c8 (sources unchanged from git_base; 498/622 source locks match)

parts.owner_pin_map: fact-c74561-polarity (component-renewal-input-protection): pin 1 = cathode at local -X, stripe identifies cathode
parts.footprint_mark: F.Fab cathode bar at local x = -1.75 (pad 1 side); F.SilkS outline brackets only
parts.model_mark: SMA_Littelfuse_SMAJ16A_C74561.wrl: light band on the top face at x = -1.57..-1.32 mm (pad 1 side); model is an illustrative SMA body (owner fact), not a manufacturer model
parts.local_result: PASS: cathode, pad 1 and VBUS_IN coincide in footprint, model and pin map
parts.order_step_check: In JLCPCB placement preview, the body stripe must sit on the pad toward the board's left (smaller X), i.e. the VBUS_IN pad

parts.owner_pin_map: fact-c192739-polarity (component-bzt52c18-7-f, PRIMARY-SPEC): cathode band; pad 1 = cathode
parts.footprint_mark: F.SilkS double cathode bar at local x = -0.97 / -0.83 and pin-1 dot at (-1.85, 0.9)
parts.model_mark: SOD-123_L2.8-W1.8-LS3.7-RD.wrl: band on the top face at x = -0.91..-0.74 mm (pad 1 side)
parts.local_result: PASS: cathode, pad 1 and VDD_LOC coincide in footprint, model and pin map
parts.if_reversed: clamps VDD near 0.7 V; the STUSB4500 never powers
parts.order_step_check: In JLCPCB placement preview, the band must sit on the VDD_LOC pad (smaller X)

parts.owner_pin_map: pinmap-c696190 / fact-c696190-candidate-scope (component-project-passives): C11.1 GND = positive terminal
parts.footprint_mark: F.SilkS chamfered corners and '+' on the pad 1 side, '-' on the pad 2 side
parts.model_mark: CAP-SMD_BD8.0-L8.3-W8.3-LS9.1-FD.wrl carries no colour-separated polarity mark; the model does not add evidence
parts.local_result: PASS for footprint and pin map; model NOT APPLICABLE
parts.if_reversed: about 14 V reverse bias on the electrolytic
parts.order_step_check: Only applies if new Board Bs are assembled. In JLCPCB placement preview, the base-plate chamfers / + mark must sit on the GND pad (smaller X)
